title: Loading one row field
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a binary input word, and let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$. Choose a field index $i<l$, old words for all $l$ fields, and binary words $pre$, $word$, and $tail$. The row loader, started at field $i$ with the old fields and stream $pre$ followed by the encoding of $word$ and $tail$, reaches in a time $t$ satisfying $0<t\le 2|old_i|+3|word|+7$ a configuration in which field $i$ contains $word$, the field index is $i+1$, and the stream cursor is at position $|pre|+2|word|+2$, with the other fields and the stream contents as specified by the target configuration.
hypotheses_covered: old assigns a binary word to each of the $l$ fields
replaced: For every input word, input position, target field $i$, old field words, stream prefix $u$, field word $w$, and stream tail, there is a strictly positive time $t$, at most twice the old field's length plus $3|w| + 7$, after which the row loader has replaced field $i$ by $w$, advanced its field index to $i + 1$, and moved the stream cursor exactly past the consumed field, from $|u|$ to $|u| + 2|w| + 2$; the cost includes target reset, native parsing, target rewind, and one dispatch.
